text: 🧱 THE DAILY BLOCK · THU 8 OCT ₿ BTC $82,788 (-0.6%) · ETH $2,559 (-0.6%) · Fear & Greed 64 🇮🇳 NIFTY ~22,353 (-1.1%) · SENSEX ~72,059 (-0.8%) at 2:25pm IST 💸 Money got dearer everywhere at once. The Fed's minutes show most officials expect another rate rise this year, and the US 10-year yield touched its highest since 2002. That landed a day after the RBI hiked. 🧲 Why it matters: when the safest loan in the world pays over 5% a year, a risky asset has to promise much more to win the same money. That pull hits crypto and stocks together. ⚡ Crypto sold off on two engines. About $651M of bullish bets made with borrowed money were force-closed in 24 hours, 91% of the total. US ether funds have lost money seven trading days in a row. Open bets barely fell, so most of the borrowed money is still in play. 🇮🇳 India felt the squeeze. Brent crude climbed above $104, foreign funds sold for a ninth straight day, and PNB, Bank of Baroda and others raised loan rates after the RBI move. 📒 New here?
